stories.title: Aeronave cai nos trilhos do metrô de Belo Horizonte logo após decolar do Aeroporto da Pampulha

en.title: Aircraft falls onto metro tracks in Belo Horizonte shortly after takeoff from Pampulha Airport
en.summary: An Embraer Corisco Turbo aircraft crashed onto metro rails in Belo Horizonte on Friday morning shortly after departing from Pampulha Airport.

stories.title: Trump cria comitê para investigar novamente diretora do Fed

en.title: Trump creates committee to investigate Federal Reserve director again
en.summary: US President Donald Trump established a committee to investigate Federal Reserve director Lisa Cook over allegations she made false statements related to real estate financing.

stories.title: Queimadas quase quadruplicam no Amazonas, e Manaus fica sob fumaça; entenda o cenário

en.title: Fires nearly quadruple in Amazon region, and Manaus shrouded in smoke; understand the scenario
en.summary: Smoke from wildfires has blanketed the city of Manaus in September, with the Amazon state recording nearly four times more heat sources than the same month in 2025, following a period of scarce rainfall.

stories.title: EUA impõem novas sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional após Nobel da Paz a jurista sul-africana

en.title: US imposes new sanctions on International Criminal Court after Peace Nobel awarded to South African jurist
en.summary: The US government under President Donald Trump announced additional sanctions against the International Criminal Court hours after South African jurist Navi Pillay, who worked at the court, received the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Governo vai zerar tributação sobre gasolina em meio às eleições e impacto passa a R$ 2,8 bi por mês

en.title: Government will zero taxation on gasoline amid elections and impact reaches R$ 2.8 billion per month
en.summary: The government is eliminating federal taxes on gasoline during the election period, resulting in a monthly fiscal impact of R$ 2.8 billion.

stories.title: Mendonça e Kassio mandam tirar vídeos em que Lula e Janja falam em corte de ações sociais por Flávio

en.title: Mendonça and Kassio order removal of videos in which Lula and Janja speak of cuts to social actions by Flávio
en.summary: Electoral court officials ordered the removal of videos published by presidential candidate Lula that made claims against rival Flávio Bolsonaro without concrete supporting evidence.

stories.title: Pode ser que eu divida com Trump, ironiza Navi Pillay sobre Nobel da Paz recebido; veja vídeo

en.title: It may be that I share with Trump, jokes Navi Pillay about Nobel Peace Prize received; see video
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay joked about potentially sharing her Nobel Peace Prize with U.S. President Donald Trump upon learning she had won the award.

stories.title: Governo zera imposto federal da gasolina e renova subsídio do etanol a 16 dias das eleições; custo é de R$ 5,2 bi

en.title: Government zeroes federal gasoline tax and renews ethanol subsidy 16 days before elections; cost is R$ 5.2 billion
en.summary: The Lula government announced the renewal and expansion of federal tax relief on ethanol and gasoline plus a new diesel import subsidy two weeks before the presidential runoff election.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera votação no 1º turno nas 10 cidades que mais perderam empregos no Brasil

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leads voting in first round in 10 Brazilian cities that lost the most jobs
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received the most votes in the first round of presidential elections across the ten Brazilian municipalities with the largest relative losses of formal employment over one year, among cities with over 10,000 registered workers.

stories.title: EUA impõem sanções contra o Tribunal Penal Internacional após Navi Pillay ganhar Nobel da Paz

en.title: USA imposes sanctions against International Criminal Court after Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The United States imposed sanctions against the International Criminal Court in response to the Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay.

stories.title: TSE: ministros ordenam que Lula e Janja removam vídeos contra Flávio

en.title: TSE: ministers order Lula and Janja to remove videos against Flávio
en.summary: Electoral court ministers ordered the removal of videos posted by first lady Janja and other accounts warning about potential cuts to social programs if senator Flávio Bolsonaro won the presidential election.

stories.title: Douglas Ruas diz que buscará para Flávio Bolsonaro votos de quem se absteve no 1º turno do RJ

en.title: Douglas Ruas says he will seek votes for Flávio Bolsonaro from those who abstained in RJ first round
en.summary: Newly elected Rio de Janeiro governor Douglas Ruas stated he will work to obtain votes for senator Flávio Bolsonaro from voters who abstained in the first round of the presidential election in the state.

stories.title: Lula diz no DF que país não será 'de parentes do Vorcaro' e retoma discurso antiarmamentista

en.title: Lula says in DF that country will not be 'of Vorcaro relatives' and resumes anti-armament discourse
en.summary: President Lula campaigned in Brasília's Federal District, stating Brazil will never belong to relatives of former banker Daniel Vorcaro. He renewed anti-armament rhetoric and pledged to prosecute those involved in a banking scandal.

stories.title: Ibovespa bate novo recorde intradiário e dólar aprofunda queda com eleição no foco

en.title: Ibovespa hits new intraday record and dollar deepens decline with election in focus
en.summary: Brazil's stock index reached a new intraday high while the dollar fell further amid election-related market movements. Future interest rates declined despite strong inflation data, as technology stocks recovered internationally.

stories.title: Aeronave cai no pátio de manutenção do metrô em Belo Horizonte

en.title: Small aircraft crashes in metro maintenance yard in Belo Horizonte
en.summary: A single-engine plane crashed in Belo Horizonte's metro maintenance yard, killing the pilot. The aircraft struck a hangar structure and electrical wiring while flying low in the area.

stories.title: Após sanções dos EUA, TPI pede a Estados-membros que assegurem condições de funcionamento

en.title: After US sanctions, ICC requests member states ensure operational conditions
en.summary: The International Criminal Court rejected US sanctions and asked member states to ensure the institution can continue operating. The sanctions were announced after a former ICC judge received the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: Brasil supera 62 mil academias em dez anos de expansão

en.title: Brazil surpasses 62,000 gyms in ten years of expansion
en.summary: Brazil's gym market nearly tripled over a decade, growing from 22,581 facilities in 2015 to 62,718 in 2025. The sector is shifting from expansion metrics to evaluating networks based on management capacity and operational consistency.
